theme: First, then, next, last: the planting story in order

activities.title: The planting story, in order
activities.intro: Listen to the cards. They are the steps of planting a seed, all jumbled up. Put them in order, the first one first, all the way to the last one.
activities.offScreen: Tell a grown up the four steps of planting a seed, using your hands to show each one.

rounds.prompt: First we dig a little hole. Then we drop the seed in. Put these two in order, first one first.
Dig a little hole, drop the seed in, cover it up with soil. Put the three in order, first one first.
The whole planting story now. Dig the hole, drop the seed in, cover it up, give it a drink. Put all four in order.

items.sound: give it a drink of water

rounds.prompt: Now the growing story. A little seed, a tiny sprout poking up, big green leaves, a flower. Put all four in order.

activities.title: What comes next?
activities.intro: Listen to the story so far. Then look at the last two cards and tap the one that comes next.
activities.offScreen: Ask a grown up to start a story about your day and stop in the middle, and you say what comes next.

rounds.prompt: Dig the hole, drop the seed in, cover it up with soil. What comes next?

items.sound: give it a drink of water

rounds.prompt: A little seed, a tiny sprout, big green leaves. What comes next?
Water, sunshine, water, sunshine. What comes next?
Dig the hole, drop the seed in. What comes next?

activities.title: What does a seed need?
activities.intro: Listen to all four. Three of them help a seed grow into a plant, and one of them does not. Tap the one that does not.
activities.offScreen: Go and find one thing in the house that would help a seed grow, and bring it to a grown up.

rounds.prompt: Water, sunshine, soil, a shoe. Tap the one that does not help a seed grow.
Water, a drum, soil, sunshine. Tap the one that does not help a seed grow.
A spoon, water, sunshine, soil. Tap the one that does not help a seed grow.
Soil, water, a fish, sunshine. Tap the one that does not help a seed grow.

parentCard.title: The planting walk
steps: Before you go out, put the cup, the soil and the beans by the door and let them carry one of them. Say the four words they are going to need, and let them say them back: dig, drop, cover, water.
Outside, do it together and say each step out loud as it happens. First we dig. Then we drop the seed in. Next we cover it up. Last we give it a drink.

Stop and ask the why question of the week, and let their answer be the answer: what do you think the seed needs now, to turn into a plant? Wonder together about what it is doing down there in the dark where nobody can see it.
Let them choose where the cup lives, somewhere they will walk past every day, and put it there themselves.
On the way back in, find a plant already growing outside and ask which of the four steps somebody must have done for it.
notice: Do they say the four steps in order on their own, or do they still need the first word of each one?
When you ask what the seed needs, do they name something they can see, like water, or something they cannot, like time?
Do they go back to look at the cup later in the day without being asked?
